report.narrative: Fire reported in a apartment block on Bell Way. About 5 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. Flames and smoke are visible.
Heat and crowding at a gathering on Bailey Avenue, many feel faint. About 7 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet.
A storage tank is leaking on Hamilton Street and people are coughing. About 5 people are hurt. 1 looks badly hurt. There is a strong chemical smell.
A storage tank is leaking on Smith Street and people are coughing. Caller thinks maybe 5 people are hurt but cannot be sure. 1 looks badly hurt. There is a strong chemical smell.
Crowd surge at an event on Mccoy Lane, people are on the ground. About 4 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet.
Part of a school annex on Moore Street has collapsed. Caller thinks maybe 4 people are hurt but cannot be sure. 4 look badly hurt. Someone is trapped. Debris is still coming down.
Crowd surge at an event on Richards Avenue, people are on the ground. About 4 people are hurt. 2 look badly hurt.
Chain-reaction collision on Cobb Road, caller is standing nearby. About 2 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet.
Crowd surge at an event on Miller Lane, people are on the ground. About 8 people are hurt. 1 looks badly hurt.
Fire reported in a warehouse on Valencia Street. About 4 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. Flames and smoke are visible.
Multiple cars collided on Mcneil Lane and traffic has stopped. About 3 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. Someone is trapped. Flames and smoke are visible.
A floor gave way in a office building on Garcia Road. About 4 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. Debris is still coming down.

meta.description: Mixed urban mass-casualty day: crashes, fires, a collapse, a spill and a crowd event.
